Ethanol plants get fresh interest subsidy

The state cabinet has approved an additional interest subsidy for grain-based ethanol plants to sustain the blending push.

Officials said 12 distilleries under construction would benefit, protecting investments made after the ethanol policy revision.

Industry representatives said maize growers in the Kosi belt stand to gain from assured procurement linkages.

The subsidy outgo is capped and will be reviewed after two years, officials added.
